name: Miraculous
overview: 17th century. In the dense Siberian taiga, lives the Shlykov family of Old Believers. They guard an ancient, miraculous icon that has saved them from harm on numerous occasions. The icon formerly belonged to the boyar Morozov and came into their possession after his arrest. Rumors of the numerous miracles performed by this icon spread far and wide. The memory of the icon has endured for centuries.
